Field(s) not matched as expected: business_address

performance.note: Gold/Paddle sample processing_ms is downstream scorer time; total_seconds is wall-clock baseline runtime including OCR.

metric_definitions.ocr_cer: Levenshtein distance over whitespace-stripped gold OCR text divided by gold character count.
metric_definitions.ocr_text_similarity: difflib SequenceMatcher ratio over whitespace-stripped gold OCR text and OCR text.
metric_definitions.classification_accuracy: Samples with predicted document_type equal to gold document_type divided by scored samples.
metric_definitions.field_accuracy: Required fields with normalized predicted value exactly equal to normalized gold value divided by required fields.
metric_definitions.document_level_success: Supported-document samples where every required field is correct divided by supported-document samples.
metric_definitions.validation_accuracy: Samples with predicted validation status equal to gold validation status divided by validation-labeled samples.
metric_definitions.false_pass_count: Validation-labeled samples where gold status is not PASS but predicted status is PASS.
metric_definitions.review_rate: Classification needs_review count divided by scored samples.
